name: icons-r11
note: Owner 2026-11-08: an original padlock icon to replace the 🔒 emoji on locked crafting slots, locked Trade Stall slots, the level lock and the bulk-crafting note. System style, square glyph, reads at 20 px.

lock.prompt: CONTROL: the SECOND attached sheet holds this game's approved Home and clock-tower glyphs: match their rendering, outline weight, colours and SIZE IN THE CELL exactly, so the new icons are one set with them. SUBJECTS: four PADLOCK icons, in order on the 3 x 3 grid, left to right then top to bottom, ONE icon per grid cell, centred in its cell and well inside it, each a SQUARE glyph of a few big simple shapes with thick dark outlines and no small details, that still reads at 20 pixels: 1 LOCK: the classic closed padlock, a rounded golden brass body with a dark keyhole and a thick dark iron shackle arched over it, seen flat from the front. 2 LOCK ALTERNATE: the same padlock with a dark iron body and a brass shackle. 3 LOCK ALTERNATE B: the same brass padlock, squarer body, the shackle a little wider. 4 LOCK OPEN: the brass padlock of 1 with its shackle swung open to the right. Cells 5 to 9 stay EMPTY, pure flat magenta, nothing drawn in them.
